parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically found in a cooling fan. It consists of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air within a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor, converting electrical energy into mechanical airflow.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the cooling fan, made of ABS plastic. It provides structural support and houses the fan blades and motor.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the fan assembly in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation. It also provides mounting points for installation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as the fixed support structure for the rotating fan.
